name: Arab Dairy Products Co.
source: stockanalysis.com (secondary data provider, figures as reported by that provider, not read from the exchange filing) | EGXNOTE 17 Nov 2026: askborsa carries the published FY 2025 results for ADPC with net profit of -183 million EGP -288.7% (https://askborsa.com/en/company/ADPC/fy-2025). That English summary publishes net profit and gross profit only, not the ten income lines this panel renders, so no column was written rather than a year with two cells filled and eight blank. | CRON 2026-11-28: FY2025 column added. Figures printed by two independent providers, not derived except where tagged. Revenue, Gross Profit and the Cost of Sales difference are from the Reuters LSEG annual income statement (millions EGP, converted to absolute EGP); Net Profit is the audited figure published in the company's own Egyptian Exchange results disclosure. Rows not printed by any reachable free source (Operating Expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT), Net Finance Costs, Profit Before Tax, Income Tax, EPS) are left empty rather than estimated; the free EGX summaries publish only the top and bottom line. The stored earlier years reproduce the same provider exactly on the overlapping year, which is why these rows are on the same basis. Carrier of the FY2025 figures: Reuters/LSEG annual income statement lists 2025 revenue 2,575.63 million EGP against 3,082.83 million in 2024, gross profit 524.58 million against 709.38 million, both on the basis already stored here (FY2024 stored revenue 3,083,000,000 and gross profit 709,380,000 match the provider to the million). Net loss 183,171,393 EGP for the consolidated year ended 31 December 2025 is the audited figure in the EGX disclosure of 2 April 2026 (NewsID 285817), with the 2024 comparative 97,085,359 matching the stored FY2024 net profit basis (attributable to the parent). Cost of Sales is the difference between the two printed figures (Revenue less Gross Profit) and therefore ties by construction. The board report filed with the statements prints total sales of 2,472,872 thousand EGP (local 1,513,344 plus export 959,528), which is the company's own sales measure and differs from the provider revenue by other operating income; the provider figure is stored to keep the series on one basis.
note: Figures in the unit shown, converted from the provider's millions EGP. Each fiscal year header cell was matched to its own data cell, so the provider trailing twelve month column is excluded. Every printed identity ties: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, and profit before tax less income tax equals net profit. Net profit for periods carrying a minority interest is the profit for the year before that interest, which the provider prints as earnings from continuing operations.
